label:
<think>
The compilation errors arise because jakarta.mvc-api 2.0.1 moved all MVC types from the javax.mvc.* namespace to jakarta.mvc.* as part of the Jakarta EE 9 namespace change. The client code still imports javax.mvc.* packages (Controller, Models, UriRef, BindingResult, MvcBinding, ParamError, CsrfProtected). The fix is to update these imports to their jakarta.mvc.* equivalents. Method signatures like BindingResult.isFailed() and getAllErrors() likely remain unchanged, so only import updates are necessary. No function signatures or other code require modification. Ensure the replacement covers a contiguous block of the MVC-related imports.
</think>
